subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: I was up at 2AM, heartbroken, when I made a decision that almost ruined this app. Here's what happened.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM. I was sitting on my kitchen floor, staring at my phone. I’d just gotten another ‘I miss you’ text from my ex. And for a second, I almost deleted the entire app. I thought, ‘Who am I to help anyone? I’m a mess.’ That was the mistake.

The truth is, I built Fresh Start from that exact feeling. The 3AM spiral. The obsessive thought loops. The identity crisis where you don’t even recognize yourself. I was so deep in it, I almost threw away the one thing that could actually help—not just me, but you. That night, I realized the app needed a feature for the exact moment you feel completely, utterly lost.

That’s why I built the Emergency Mode. It’s not just a button. It’s the 2AM kitchen floor moment, coded into an app. It doesn’t ask you to journal or track your mood. It just gives you a lifeline—a calm voice, a grounding exercise, a way to breathe—when you’re sure you’re breaking.

Tap the button below. Open the app and just look at the Emergency Mode icon. Know it’s there for your 2AM. You don’t have to use it now. Just know it exists. P.S. The first person to use it after a 2AM text was me. It works.
